cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.description: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Meowscarada
cards.description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.description: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

cards.name: Skeledirge
cards.description: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.description: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.description: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.description: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Quaquaval
cards.description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.description: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.description: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.description: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.

cards.name: Klawf
cards.description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Bombirdier
cards.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.description: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.description: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

cards.name: Squawkabilly
cards.description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as "synchronizing," an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
